newsitem.title: FRANCE: HORSE RACING-BRILLIANCE WINS PRIX SAINT-ALARY.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-BRILLIANCE WINS PRIX SAINT-ALARY.

text.p: Brilliance maintained her 100 percent this season and booked her place for the Prix de Diane (French Oaks) with an easy win in the Group One Prix Saint-Alary at Longchamp on Sunday.
Untroubled by the very soft ground, Olivier Peslier's mount waited in fifth place behind the front running Irish filly Family Tradition in the early stages of the 10-furlong race.
She looked under pressure two furlongs from home when Fleeting Glimpse, ridden by Thierry Jarnet, dashed into the lead.

But Brilliance took charge again with a furlong to go and stretched away to win by four lengths from Fleeting Glimpse. Gazelle Royale, ridden by Thierry Thulliez, was a short head further back in third place.

Favourite Darashadeh was the disappointment of the race, finishing fourth. Unlucky not to have beaten Brilliance in the group three Prix Penelope, the Aga Khan filly finished five and a half lengths behind her rival on Sunday.
Trainer Pascal Bary confirmed after the race that Brilliance would be aimed at next month's Prix de Diane.
